messages:
lee: Quick follow-up from the postmortem this morning on streaming/chat instability. Goal: assign owners, short timelines, and a pattern-detector for repeats. Keep replies brief.
ops-bot: Created follow-up card: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2034 :spiral_note_pad:
anya: Symptoms recap: intermittent partial streams (~0.7% of requests), increased client reconnect loops, and bursts of server-side handshake timeouts.
kai: Draft action list (suggested):
- ACTION 1: Client default backoff + exponential jitter (owner: kai) 1d spec, 10d PR
- ACTION 2: Server-side partial detection + scoring (owner: anya) 3w implementation, flagged deploy
- ACTION 3: Alert + synthetic that detects partial clusters (owner: sara) 3d to dashboard
- ACTION 4: Runbook + quick mitigation steps for oncall (owner: lee) 36h
- ACTION 5: Recurrence job that fingerprints incidents and auto-escalates (owner: kai) 10d
sara: For ACTION 3 I propose this PromQL for the alert: 
```promql
(sum(rate(chat_stream_partials_total[5m])) / sum(rate(chat_stream_requests_total[5m]))) * 100 > 0.5
```
Trigger if condition holds for 3 consecutive 5m windows.
anya: Will add a dashboard tile with breakdown by model, route, and edge node. Also adding metric: chat.partial_gap_ms (time from connection to first partial).
kai: Client snippet (Go) for jittered backoff to add to SDK defaults:
```go
func BackoffMillis(attempt int) int {
  base := 50 * (1 << attempt)
  if base > 1000 { base = 1000 }
  jitter := rand.Float64() * 0.35 // up to 35%
  return int(float64(base) * (1 + jitter))
}
```
lee: Runbook checklist (short): 1) check top-10 routes by partials, 2) inspect connection pool saturation, 3) verify KV cache hit rates, 4) toggle handshake-timeout flag if needed, 5) enable debug logging for 2 deploys.
sara: Synthetic test plan: create a worker that injects partial chunk after X ms and measures recovery time/reconnect loops. Add to infra-e2e and run nightly for 14 days. ETA 9 days.
kai: Recurrence detector: cron job runs daily, groups incidents by fingerprint (timeout+partial pattern), if > 2 occurrences in 30 days auto-create infra review ticket and ping infra slack channel. I'll post the cron and skeleton ticket template by EOD.
ops-bot: Oncall assignment for follow-up window: @kai (week 1), @anya (week 2).
lee: Targets: reduce partial/timeout customer impact by >=75% in 30 days and remove noisy client retries. Can everybody drop PR/issue links in the follow-up card by COB tomorrow?
anya: I'll take the server detection prototype and add a feature-flagged endpoint. PR link when opened.
sara: Will create the alert in Grafana and add runbook play link to the alert.
kai: I'll open SDK PR and recurrence job issue: https://git.redwood/p/kai/sdk-backoff and https://git.redwood/p/kai/recurrence-detector
lee: Perfect. I'll track progress on the remediation board and schedule a 15m check-in in 48h. ops-bot please create the calendar reminder.
ops-bot: Check-in scheduled in 48h. Follow-up ticket updated.
lee: Thanks all 1 Let's keep updates short and put links in the card. Aim for a smooth, flag-guarded rollout.
